rows.subject: ai
rows.trigger: Re-diagnosis (DERIVED, from sub_41AD80 itself; the packet-gate claim is withdrawn). The AI-AI branch runs only when neither car is the player. Gates in order: (1) dword_7D0308 != 0 and flt_7CF3C8 != 0 and dword_7C56A8 != 8 (functions/sub_41AD80_0041ad80.c:~22-24); (2) per-car 2 s guard: dbl_8AFEA0 - 2.0 > this[slot+319] for BOTH cars (c.22-24); (3) impact a4 > 1250.0 (c.24). The per-car timestamps are written BEFORE the emit, so any earlier contact of either car blocks later lines for 2 s. (4) the random gate: flt_8AB274[(u8)dword_8AAE70++] > 0 picks 225, otherwise 226 (c.41-50 vs c.60-70). The cursor is shared with AudioEventRingBufferProcessing_004feaf0.c:64 (same table, same cursor), so the pick depends on audio traffic. It cannot silence the event: both branches emit. (5) InsertDriverTableEntry (functions/InsertDriverTableEntry_00418560.c): ScoreThresholdGateCheck on the score dword_5BF9A0[5*eid] (dump score 228 for 225) passes for settings 1-3 (functions/ScoreThresholdGateCheck_00418b90.c). The entry goes into a 20-slot list sorted by play time; when full, the lowest-score entry is evicted; if the new time is not earlier than any slot, the insert returns 0 with no log. (6) cooldown: the dump gives cd 1.0 for 225 (not FLT_MAX, so NOT blocked). SPEC_EVF-008_D's cd 30.0 is not supported by the table read; treated as wrong. The cooldown only sets the entry's expiry (this[3] = play time + cd + 0.2); whether expired entries are dropped at play time is UNVERIFIED. (7) player contacts reach the same a4 > 1250 gate and their lines (114/115) were heard in vanilla, so the threshold is reachable by real contacts; AI-AI contacts may simply stay below it. Conclusion: no cooldown fix is needed. The silence is one of: AI-AI impact <= 1250, the 2 s per-car guard, queue eviction or rejection, or unverified expiry. The next step is measurement, not a patch. Line 225 is the primary of the random pick.
